title: is_public_path pins omit the /wrong-person and /decline routes the new landing page links to
detail: The landing page renders links to /reference/<token>/wrong-person and /decline, but the new is_public_path pins cover only the bare token path, /answer, and /resend. If those two GETs need session-less whitelisting, the exact r1 gap class recurs untested.
recommended_fix: Add is_public_path tests for ["reference", token, "wrong-person"] and ["reference", token, "decline"], mirroring reference_answer_is_public_test, or document why those routes are exempt.

title: const token named 'test-token-48-chars' is 19 characters, not 48
detail: The constant name asserts a 48-char token, but the value is 19 characters. If production capability tokens are 48 chars, these SSR pins render a non-representative token and any length-sensitive view behavior would be missed.
recommended_fix: Use a realistic token (e.g. a 48-char 'ref-' string) or rename the constant to match the actual fixture length.

title: open_vars fixture differs between questions_test and form_copy_test: employer_name only cleared in form_copy_test
detail: Same-name fixtures in the same chunk define the 'no prefill' state differently. questions_test's open_vars leaves employer_name populated, so any future open-variant test for q_works_at would silently exercise the prefilled branch.
recommended_fix: Align the two open_vars fixtures (clear employer_name in questions_test too) or rename one to avoid the misleading collision.

title: no_banned_error_vocabulary_test only matches exact-case 'Error'/'Failed'; lowercase variants pass
detail: The stated contract is a vocabulary ban ("never blame"), but the assertions are case-sensitive substring checks. Copy containing 'error' or 'failed' in lowercase would pass the test and ship against the brand-voice rule.
recommended_fix: Lowercase each string before asserting (string.lowercase(s) |> string.contains("error") and "failed"), matching the contract's intent.
